svg.text: Unknowing: which of 21 geomagnetic storms (2025) each reading named
columns: storms by peak Kp, weakest left; purple: found; amber: my forecast of a fresh reader
left of the dashed line: the seven storms at 6−, counted by this experiment's norm; no fresh reading named one.
Data: GFZ Potsdam Kp, CC BY 4.0 (doi:10.5880/Kp.0001). Readers: copies of one reader, 8 without memory, 8 with.
